description: Extract a bounded section of text. Missing or null text uses empty text, start defaults to zero, length may be omitted to keep the remaining text, and values outside 0 through 65536 or a negative length fail before output.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to slice. Missing or null input is treated as empty text; values longer than 65536 characters fail before output.

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Zero-based character position where the slice starts. Missing or null input uses zero; values outside 0 through 65536 fail before output.

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Maximum number of characters to return. Omit this input to keep the remaining text; values outside 0 through 65536, including negative values, fail before output.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the selected text, limited by the value length and optional length input.

description: Split text using a literal delimiter. Missing or null text uses empty text, a missing or null delimiter uses a comma, and text or delimiter values outside 65536 characters fail before output.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to split. Missing or null input is treated as empty text; values longer than 65536 characters fail before output.

inputs.name: delimiter
inputs.description: Literal text that separates parts. Missing or null input uses a comma; values longer than 65536 characters fail before output.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the parts in order after splitting with the literal delimiter, including empty parts.

description: Find the first index of a substring in text. Missing or null inputs use empty text, and -1 means the substring was not found.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to search. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: substring
inputs.description: Text to find. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: index
outputs.description: The zero-based index of the first substring occurrence, or -1 when it is absent.

description: Find the last index of a substring in text. Missing or null inputs use empty text, and -1 means the substring was not found.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to search. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: substring
inputs.description: Text to find. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: index
outputs.description: The zero-based index of the last substring occurrence, or -1 when it is absent.
